# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b105 — clickable sensors, real multi-sensor trends, compact folds

Built directly on validated v0.6.0b104. Climate PID, manual intervention, native command acknowledgment, windows, sleep, weather, cover-motor safety and control authorization are unchanged.

- **AQI spacing:** 5px inline-flex gap and 3px value/unit margins prevent "12US AQI" from touching, without reintroducing horizontal scrollbars.
- **Provenance-aware measurements:** A small ∼/average icon appears ONLY when at least two valid physical sensor entities contribute to the displayed arithmetic mean. Missing, stale and unknown inputs do not count as contributors. Room temperature, humidity, PM, CO₂, lux and other supported normalized metrics are tracked separately.
- **Source links:** A reading from exactly one real Home Assistant sensor opens that native sensor's More Info when clicked or activated by keyboard, including compact room summaries, detailed reading tiles, exterior AQI, and physical window contacts. Derived metrics never masquerade as native sources.
- **Click average for its trend:** A read-only chart shows the bounded history of that precise contributing source set, with contributor names opening their original entities. HEM stores one normalized arithmetic mean at most every 15 minutes for up to seven days (maximum 672 points per area/metric). Source-set changes start a new series; one available sensor cannot silently contaminate historical multi-sensor means. Persisted with the existing Home Assistant environmental history Store, no Recorder queries or new devices. Charts never invent data before samples exist.
- **Building physics:** Its existing estimates appear within a collapsed-by-default section. The summary displays the title and at most two real, available physics estimates, while all calculations and explanations remain expanded on demand.
- **Covers:** Solar-shade control is folded by default. The compact summary shows the physical cover-state icons for up to four selected native covers and its existing authorized ON/OFF button. The control button appears only while collapsed; expanding displays existing per-cover entity links, diagnostic text and status. No new physical cover commands or broader automation permissions.
- **Persistence and integrity:** Native room, physics and cover fold state survives routine Home Assistant updates. Trend and native entity actions are scoped to currently displayed, correctly associated source IDs. The average chart stays open during refresh and closes when contributor identity changes.
- **No horizontal scrollers** are introduced in the dashboard; lengthy trends scroll within their explicitly opened detail dialog without visible scrollbar chrome.

Includes strict backend regression tests for history persistence/source membership and real Chromium tests for average-vs-single badges, source actions, folded physics/covers, unchanged native shade controls, responsive layouts and AQI spacing. The complete inherited Beta104 safety and card regression suites gate publication.

No live physical devices have been touched or validated.
